drafted_from: tool row in tools/office-files/tool-rows.json, do-work/apply-declared-presentation-text-edits.mjs and test/apply-presentation-edits.test.mjs (run on its stand-in runtime)
start_here: Say to your AI: "In /work/in.pptx change 'harbour tour' to 'Welcome to the lighthouse tour' on slide 1, set its notes to 'Greet everyone', change 'ten coins' on slide 2 to 'Pricing starts at twelve coins', delete slide 3, and put slide 2 first; write /work/out.pptx." It writes a request file and runs apply-declared-presentation-text-edits.mjs on your computer.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it reads or rewrites one file on the person's own computer and prints what it found or changed.
instructions: 1. If you do not know your presentation runtime's property names, run tool:describe-a-presentation-runtime first.

2. Write the request JSON: runtimeModule, source, output, slides (edits by ORIGINAL slide number: replace_text, notes, or a whole rebuild), delete and slide_order, plus fonts when you rebuild a slide.

3. The AI reads the row with tools:list {tool: tool:edit-a-presentations-text} and runs its `run` command with --request. Read the last JSON: a replace_text rule with matched 0 changed nothing; exit 2 means slide_order did not list every surviving slide exactly once.
4. Tell the person the readback titles in final order and the notes: the readback, not the request, is the proof; the source file is never changed.

worked_examples.title: Reword, delete and reorder slides
worked_examples.ask: Change the harbour tour title, set slide 1's notes, reword slide 2, delete slide 3 and put slide 2 first.
worked_examples.given: From tools/office-files/test/apply-presentation-edits.test.mjs (replace_text, notes, delete and slide_order apply by original index and the readback shows the result); I ran the editor on its stand-in runtime and three-slide deck. Command: node tools/office-files/do-work/apply-declared-presentation-text-edits.mjs --request /work/request.json, where request.json is {"runtimeModule":"/work/runtime.mjs","source":"/work/in.pptx","output":"/work/out.pptx","slides":[{"index":1,"replace_text":[{"contains":"harbour tour","with":"Welcome to the lighthouse tour"},{"contains":"never in the deck","with":"x"}],"notes":"Greet everyone"},{"index":2,"replace_text":[{"contains":"ten coins","with":"Pricing starts at twelve coins"}]}],"delete":[3],"slide_order":[2,1]}.
worked_examples.hands_back: {"output":"/work/out.pptx","slideCount":2,"edits":[{"index":1,"replace_text":[{"contains":"harbour tour","matched":1},{"contains":"never in the deck","matched":0}],"notes":true},{"index":2,"replace_text":[{"contains":"ten coins","matched":1}]}],"readback":[{"slide":1,"title":"Pricing starts at twelve coins","notes":""},{"slide":2,"title":"Welcome to the lighthouse tour","notes":"Greet everyone"}]}
